The submit and Accepted fixtures are reduced from responses observed in LeetCode's live UI on 2026-09-08. The existing solution was resubmitted and accepted. IDs are replaced; timestamps, source code, usernames, cookies, performance results, and irrelevant fields are excluded. Observed endpoints: POST /problems/<slug>/submit/ and GET /submissions/detail/<id>/v2/check/. Other verdict cases in tests are synthetic negative cases, not live captures.
